receipt_status.MATERIALIZED_PASS: hash-bound artifacts may feed M36 train in the same Nextflow run
receipt_status.PUBLISHED_PASS: post-publication binding adds immutable object generations without altering artifact hashes

representation_contract.zero_evaluable: implicit for sample/event pairs absent from carrier_rows and missing_rows
representation_contract.missing: sparse missing_rows or equivalent authenticated bit-packed mask
representation_contract.geometry_control: global locus axis is identical by construction and is never expanded sample-by-locus
representation_contract.minor_orientation: carrier minor_dosage is oriented to the per-locus minor allele rederived from called diploid VCF genotypes
representation_contract.callability_and_map: callability is derived from called GT denominator; cM is interpolated from the required genetic map
representation_contract.optional_context: mutation/copying contexts may be unavailable only with explicit availability masks; values are never invented

requirements: loci are one row per event; carrier and missing tables are sparse
FIT/SCORE identity must be separately authenticated
target chromosome must not equal feature chromosome
source is Nunes asIBD (Refined-IBD) stratified by Gnomix and is exploratory predictive target only, never orthogonal truth
target is log1p(sum_cM) with deterministic stratified zero negatives
receipt must bind immutable published input descriptors
